# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the unmodified UMD build of `@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0` (MIT), downloaded from:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0/dist/umd/supabase.js

It is served locally so the student portal does not execute an unpinned third-party CDN script at runtime.

Upstream source and license: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
